plan_owner_impacts.evidence: The All Settings compendium is the first surface that renders the complete 828-row inventory as a single faceted index (record kind, area, setting type, tier, changed-from-default, live row state). The inventory schema should guarantee the fields the facets depend on (tier, type, curated, search terms) stay populated for every future row, and should add a record-kind discriminator so managers/actions/diagnostics can be indexed without concept-side inference.

Compendium workspace grammar: persistent left workspace rail (Home + All Settings + 12 areas) on every Settings surface, domain pages composed as overview fact strip + curated key settings + full subgroup sections + related-managers panel, and an exact-landing contextual explanation panel (About this setting) that opens beside the located row. The spec should adopt the explanation-panel contract for deep-link landings.

Faceted-index navigation implies a small command family: open All Settings with a facet preset (changed-from-default, managed, per-area), and open a setting with its explanation panel. Registered as candidates in candidate-command-delta.json; no canon minted.

The compendium demonstrates the windowed-virtualization budget the register requires: 828 real + 2,000 synthetic rows render fewer than 40 live DOM rows at any scroll position, facet recounts are O(n) over plain records, and search stays latest-request-wins. The register can cite this as the reference implementation for long-tail Settings lists.

Provider list/detail renders the shared PMProvider resolver states verbatim (multi-install selected/shadowed, unknown-owner manual-only, ask-first updates with verify checklists, official-source Cursor CLI setup). No new provider semantics were invented; the concept only contributes the list/detail composition.

The copy preview showpiece (counts, per-area breakdown, expandable current-to-incoming diff rows, credential-by-reference note, conflict rows that are never applied without a decision) is a concrete UI contract for the one-time-transaction policy; the receipt records both directions and rollback restores exactly.

The harness deep-link probe setting system.health.diagnostics-verbosity does not exist in pm2-inventory (828 rows); the concept lands honestly on System & Advanced with an explanation instead. The census between the rev-2 dataset and the pm2 inventory should be reconciled before the probe id is treated as canonical.
